data.title: Speed challenge: even or odd?
story: Write a function number_kind(n) that returns the text "even" or "odd".
Hint: the % operator gives the remainder of a division. There are hidden tests for 0 and negative numbers!

explanation: An even number divides by 2 with nothing left, so its remainder n % 2 is 0. Zero is even too, and -3 leaves a remainder of 1, so it is still odd.
hints: Try print(7 % 2) and print(4 % 2). What is different?
Use if n % 2 == 0: and then return "even".
Outside the if, return "odd". Remember the 4-space indentation.
